parameters.prompt: The exact four-legged tiger in the reference performs ONE ordinary claw attack, staying in place. From the resting pose it slowly raises the nearer front paw and draws it back, then makes one fast strong forward and downward claw swipe toward screen left, retracts the paw and calmly places it back in the exact original stance. The other three paws stay planted. Keep the same three-quarter left view, body proportions, stripes, face and tail throughout. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green background. Entire tiger, extended paw and tail remain inside the frame with clear margins. No leap, walking, turning, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, particles, claw trails, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second prepare, second second wind up, a brief swipe around the middle, then recover and hold the original pose.
